INSERT INTO t (v) VALUES ('during the partition');
blocks.out:
after 3.0 s the client is still waiting
pg_stat_activity: wait_event=SyncRep, query="INSERT INTO t (v) VALUES ('during the pa"

blocks.cmd: SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid);   -- give up on the wait
blocks.out: WARNING: canceling wait for synchronous replication due to user request

blocks.cmd: SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE v = 'during the partition';
-- asynchronous, network still cut: 500 more rows on the primary
